key_concepts: Sound is a form of energy that affects daily life
Common sources of sound include voices, bells, machines, tools, instruments, animals, and
Sounds can be identified and matched to their sources
Vibration is a quick back-and-forth movement
Plucking a guitar string, striking a drumhead, or blowing into a flute causes vibrations t
When something vibrates, it creates sound
Sound travels from its source to our ears through a material such as air, water, or solid
The ears are the body parts that help us hear sounds
Sounds can be loud or soft, and loudness is how strong or soft a sound is
Some factors affect the loudness of sounds heard
Sound words such as buzz, ring, tick-tock, and strum describe different sounds
